changes: Mobile: Widgets, themes, ambient mixer and info are now available on phones as bottom sheets — they were previously desktop-only.
Timer: Pomodoro now counts real elapsed time, so a backgrounded tab no longer stretches a 25-minute block.
Timer: Durations, custom sequences and auto-start are remembered between visits; the daily tomato counter resets correctly at midnight.
Playback: Volume and your last station are restored on reload, and ambient mixes persist too.
Playback: Media keys, headset buttons and the OS lock screen now control playback via the Media Session API.
Shortcuts: Added A for ambient-only, F for immersive mode, ? for the shortcut list, 1-9 to jump between stations, and Esc to close panels.
Reliability: Channels that fail to embed are skipped once per session instead of being retried in a loop.
Reliability: The nightly link check now detects videos that disallow embedding, which oEmbed could not see.
Accessibility: Panels are keyboard-navigable with focus trapping, and every icon-only control has a label.
Ambient: Added preset mixes (Rainy Night, Forest Morning, Campfire, Storm) that fill in the sliders as a starting point — every level stays adjustable.
Sharing: Added a share button that copies a link carrying the current station, theme and ambient mix; the address bar stays in sync as you change them.
Ambient: Added an “Ambient Only” switch that mutes the music while the ambient mix keeps playing — the master mute still silences everything, toggled from the mixer or with the A key.
UI: Rebuilt the control bar — the secondary icons are now grouped instead of nine loose buttons in a row, with breathing room and clearer separators.
UI: The track title now fades at the edges while scrolling instead of being cut off mid-word.
Fix: Opening a shared link no longer jumps to a random station when you press play.
Performance: Optimized title marquee scroll to only animate when title text overflows display limits.
UX: Added floating glassmorphic HUD visual overlay feedback for keyboard shortcuts.
UX: Enabled Space key quick-start from Welcome Screen with a pulsing text hint.
Links: Integrated direct YouTube video links on player track titles.
Audio: Replaced the ambient rain sound effect with a higher quality, smoother loop.
Automation: Implemented GitHub Actions for daily YouTube link health checks.
UX: Added automatic 'broken link' detection and session-based auto-skip for interrupted streams.
Scripting: Added utility scripts for automated station pruning and metadata fetching via oEmbed API.
Content Expansion: Significant expansion of the station database with over 30+ new high-quality channels.
Architecture: Migrated station data to an externalized JSON structure for easier automation and maintenance.
New Genres: Introduced 'Deep House', 'Trip', and 'Tropical House' categories to the station roster.
Feature: Added draggable 'Info Panel' for community notices and shortcuts.
UX Improvement: 'Tune In' now randomly selects a channel for a fresh start every time.
Shortcuts: Remapped 'M' to shuffle Stations and 'N' to shuffle Channels.
Content: Added new 'J-Pop' category and expanded Lofi/R&B selections.
Visual: Refactored Welcome Screen and Menu integration.
Unified Mute: Muting the player now also silences all ambient sounds.
Visual Tweaks: Increased opacity of menus (Ambient, Stations, Themes) for better readability when overlapping.
Mobile Optimization: Station Selector is now fixed at the bottom center to prevent overlapping.
Tablet Layout: Control Panel now uses vertical stack layout on tablet (md) screens for better touch usability.
Clock Positioning: Adjusted Digital Clock dynamic positioning to adapt to vertical/horizontal Control Panel.
Mobile Experience: Automatically hide complex widgets (Notes, Tasks) on small screens for cleaner UI.
Draggable Widgets: Widget Panel is now a floating, persistent window that can be dragged anywhere.
Immersive Integration: Widgets now respect Zen Mode and auto-hide with the interface.
Assets Overhaul: New calm, abstract Favicon and atmospheric Open Graph image.
Visual Refinements: Standardized headers, repositioned clock, and enhanced transparency.
SEO: Added comprehensive Open Graph meta tags.
Theme Palette: Added 10+ themes including Classic, Retro, Cyber, and Daisy.
Multi-page Notes: Notes widget now supports 3 independent pages.
Widget Panel: Standardized height and improved layout stability.
New Genre: Added 'House' category.
UI Refinements: Improved control panel positioning and menu spacing.
Unified Menu System: Consolidated Stations, Ambient, and Widgets into a central bottom dock.
Visual Polish: Added cinematic vignette overlay and authentic dark glassmorphism.
Layout: Centered Control Panel and Menus for a balanced, symmetrical design.
Info: Added Station Category display to the Now Playing section.
Added Productivity Widgets: Pomodoro Timer, Todo List, and Notes.
Implemented Ambient Mixer with Rain, Fire, Birds, and Thunder sounds.
Added Immersive Mode (Zen Mode) to hide UI elements.
Initial Release: Lofi Radio.
Core Player: Robust YouTube playback with autoplay handling.
Station Selector: Categorized lofi channels.
